title: ERPNext 15 material request, Standard print format, Classic print style, header and footer not repeated, A4, 2 pages
notes: Material Request MAT-MR-2026-00001, submitted, purpose Purchase, dated 2026-10-21, required by 2026-11-10, target warehouse "Stores - AK", 28 lines (17 raw materials, 8 consumables, 3 spare parts and tools). Print Settings: print style Classic, PDF page size A4, Repeat Header and Footer off; other settings as the defaults. Letter Head Atelier Kiln (the default one of `erpnext15-sales-invoice`): HTML header (logo `/files/atelier-kiln-logo.png` and company address) and HTML footer (legal mentions, bank details). Captured from Frappe 15.124.0 (commit f1cf50cf9bbc) + ERPNext 15.124.1 (commit 4e0dce9ea8d3), printed through HTTP /api/method/frappe.utils.print_format.download_pdf with a logged-in session, as the print view's PDF button does. Frappe (pdfkit 1.0.0) pipes the page on stdin and reads the PDF from stdout: `-` `-` at the end; the output `-` is replaced by {out}. Frappe passed `--cookie-jar /tmp/<random>.jar` (session cookie sid); that pair is removed. The page has no #header-html / #footer-html block, so Frappe passes no header or footer page and adds `--margin-top 15mm --margin-bottom 15mm`; there are no page numbers. Origin http://127.0.0.1:8000 rewritten to http://127.0.0.1:8765 in input/page.html (no www/ file contained it). www lists the entry's own files (if any) then corpus/_shared/erpnext15/www (print CSS print.bundle.7DKZWKDD.css, same content as H34JAH53 of the first two ERPNext entries but for three comments, and the Atelier Kiln logo). httpHeaders are the Cache-Control values the Frappe server sent. The print CSS has no @font-face: the text relies on fonts installed on the machine. ERPNext parts are GPL-3.0; Frappe parts are MIT; the print CSS also bundles Bootstrap 3.3.1, normalize.css and HTML5 Boilerplate (MIT) and Quill 2.0.3 CSS (BSD-3-Clause); letter heads, images and business data were written for the corpus. See SOURCE.md.
